text:
Trevor Connelly, Vegas's first-round pick in 2024, is 20 years old and 22 games into his NHL career, and he already looks like one of the Golden Knights' best five-on-five forwards. Vegas has had about 59% of the chance quality with him on the ice, more than seven points better than without him. He has 7 goals and 12 points in about 14 minutes a night.

Speed is the calling card. NHL Edge clocks his top speed in the 99th percentile, and he has 49 bursts over 20 mph. Our wins-added measure, which credits goals by how much they swung the game, ranks him 32nd of 530 skaters. Among forwards picked near him in past drafts, the median first full season was 0.36 points a game; he is at 0.55.

The goals are running a little ahead of his chances (7 on 5.34 expected), and his last five games have produced no points. The ice time hasn't moved much, which is why SinBin.vegas ran a piece titled "It’s Time To Give Trevor Connelly A Bigger Role." What we'd watch is whether Vegas does.
headline: Trevor Connelly is already tilting the ice in Vegas
